description.value: Paradise Donair has been a New Westminster neighbourhood staple since 1998, specializing in beef, chicken, lamb, and falafel donair wraps, platters, and salads made to order. Located on 12th Street, it has established itself as a community fixture known for fresh ingredients and a broad menu that spans quick bites to full platters. Appetizers such as dolmades, samosas, and spring rolls round out the offering for cyclists looking for a complete meal stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and provides the physical address (#3 – 723 12th Street, New Westminster, BC), two phone numbers, and a detailed menu confirming an active food service business operating since 1998. Free WiFi is explicitly confirmed on the about-us page ('Free WiFi For Everyone – Ask for password to any staff'), and vegetarian options are confirmed by falafel and veggie samosa menu items. No information about bike parking, washrooms, or water refills appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, leaving all three required criteria as null.
concerns: OSM community tag lists 'Vancouver' but the website clearly places this business in New Westminster, BC — a separate municipality. The OSM coordinates (49.2101, -122.9334) are consistent with New Westminster.
URL discovery confidence is 'medium'; the website content confirms the business identity, but the URL was discovered rather than taken directly from an OSM tag.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate and active food business with confirmed WiFi, vegetarian options, and takeout that a touring cyclist would find useful, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence; field verification is recommended before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Two phone numbers appear on the website: 604.522.0789 (restaurant line) and 778.238.1592 (reservations/catering). The restaurant number is used as the primary phone field.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Vegetarian options confirmed: Falafel Donair Platter, Falafel Donair Wrap, Falafel Donair Salad, and Veggie Samosas. Vegan and gluten-free status not mentioned
